summary: ```markdown # CLO 2025.1 - 2D Function Updates This video introduces 2D function-related updates for everyone. ## AI Generator Enhancements In the 2025.0 version, we launched the AI version of the generator, which is used to make paper samples. Now it is further enhanced, and can support the input of real images. 1. **Main Menu Bar**: Select the 2D option. 2. **Version Generator**: Open the version generator. 3. **Clothing Type Selection**: Choose the clothing type according to the measurement value of the generated parameterized version. 4. **AI Version Access**: You can also use the AI version of the generator, located in the upper right corner. Click to open a new window. ### Image Upload Feature In the 2025.1 version, you can choose to upload real images. 1. **Switch to Image Options**: Click to switch to image options. 2. **Upload Clothing Image**: Click to upload the clothing you want. 3. **Start Generation**: After uploading, click to start generation. CLO will automatically draw the paper sample according to the photos uploaded. You can preview it in the window of the 2D version. Once the generation is completed, click to close. You can also continue to modify the measurement value in the version generator to achieve your ideal effect. Finally, click to create. The paper sample will be placed in the 2D window. ### Customization and Design Flexibility Now, the simple image will be converted into a custom version of the online store image you prefer, making the design process more intuitive and convenient. The 2025.1 version allows for more flexibility in defining the time limit and the time limit as either a number point or a non-number point. - **Number Point Functionality**: The number point follows the set number rule. - **Non-Number Point Adaptability**: The non-number point will smartly adapt to the movement of the number point to maintain the exact proportion of the whole paper. ### Edit Number Tool Use the edit number tool to select the actual point on the sheet for easier identification. The number point edge will be displayed in green. 1. **Right-Click Options**: Right-click on one of the number points to convert it to a non-number point. 2. **Multiple Selections**: You can select multiple number points by holding the Shift key and convert them simultaneously. The non-number point will change according to the number point movement. You can also convert the point back to a number point to fix its rule during adjustments of other points. ### Curve Number Tool Similarly, if you use the edit curve number tool, you can change the number point and identify the curve point of the number point. You can convert the curve point to a number point or a non-number point, allowing for more accurate control over the number points. ## Inner Line Alignment In the previous version, the inner line on the symmetrical board could not be directly aligned to the symmetrical axis; you had to manually move the starting point of the line section to align it. ### New Alignment Options A new option has been added in the 2025.1 version that allows you to align the inner line to the symmetrical axis for more convenient editing. 1. **Edit Version Tool**: Use the edit version tool. 2. **Right-Click Alignment**: Right-click on a point near the symmetrical axis on the inner line and select 'Align.' 3. **Select Symmetrical Axis**: Choose the new option to align to the symmetrical axis. The selected point will extend to the symmetrical axis while the point on the other side remains unchanged. ### Extending Inner Lines You can right-click on the point on the other side to align it to the outside of the board, extending the inner line outward. You can also directly right-click on the inner line and select 'Align to the symmetrical axis.' Both ends of the inner line will extend accordingly, enhancing efficiency in editing the inner line of the symmetrical board. ### Additional Functionality Previously, for the symmetrical board, if the inner line needed to be aligned to the symmetrical axis, manual adjustments were necessary. Now, with the new option, the inner line generated can extend to the symmetrical axis of the board. 1. **Selecting Lines**: Press Shift to select the middle line and the bottom curve simultaneously. 2. **Right-Click Options**: On the selected line, right-click and select 'Between the lines.' A window will pop up showing a new option at the bottom: 'Align to the symmetrical axis.' If this option is not opened, the inner line will extend to the outside of the board. When you open the option to align to the symmetrical axis, the inner line will adjust accordingly. ## Default Cutout Settings In version 2025.1, you can now set the default cutout type and length to meet your specific requirements. ### Setting User Defaults 1. **Access Main Menu Bar**: Find the main menu bar and set user default 2D. 2. **Cutout Display Settings**: Here, you can set the cutout display to either fixed screen length or actual length, and select the cutout type you prefer. - **Fixed Screen Length**: If selected, the length will be adjusted by changing the screen, and the length set in the property editor will not be editable. - **Actual Length**: When selected, it means the cutout length is fixed to the set value. For example, you can enter an actual length of 5mm and set the cutout type to 'I.' ### Cutout Tool Use Use the cutout tool to select the cutout to be added. You can modify the length in the property editor. By setting the default cutout type and length, users do not need to manually adjust the size and type of the cutout. We hope this update helps you use the cutout feature more conveniently. ```
